north_star: Become the local-first, cross-platform control plane for state created by AI agents.

phases.name: Trust & Contract
phases.goal: Repair the Python trust floor, extract executable behavior, and freeze the reference implementation.
exit_criteria: All E00 P0 defects fixed with owner-visible Safety Verdict.
Normative Python fixture/golden contract exists.
Python feature scope is frozen.

phases.name: Rust Kernel
phases.goal: Build and prove the provider-neutral Rust engine, formal safety kernel, inventory, reference adapters, and CLI cutover.
exit_criteria: Rust passes differential parity on normative corpus.
Safety kernel CR4 evidence is accepted.
Rust is canonical stable engine with rollback evidence.

phases.name: Atlas
phases.goal: Become genuinely cross-platform and make agent state understandable by machine/project/provider/artifact through CLI and TUI.
exit_criteria: macOS/Linux/Windows/WSL Tier-1 contract is met.
Artifact/project model reconciles views.
TUI provides complete inspect/explain/plan workflows.

phases.name: Govern
phases.goal: Add deterministic policy, budgets, quarantine/restore/archive, and bounded persistent memory.
exit_criteria: Policies are fully explainable and cannot override safety ceilings.
Reversible lifecycle operations survive crash/failure scenarios.
cancellAI enforces its own state budget.

phases.name: Guardian
phases.goal: Prevent runaway agent storage with predictive intelligence and bounded autonomous remediation.
exit_criteria: Pressure/anomaly detection is locally explainable.
Guardian has OS-native runtime on Tier-1 platforms.
Autonomous actions never exceed Effective Policy.

phases.name: Ecosystem
phases.goal: Scale provider coverage and ship verifiable, signed, multi-channel releases with federated compatibility knowledge.
exit_criteria: Manifest ecosystem and knowledge trust chain are operational.
Gemini/Copilot/OpenCode have truthful capability-based support.
Canonical release artifacts carry provenance/SBOM/verification evidence.

phases.name: Network & Experience
phases.goal: Extend to remote targets/fleet governance and optional desktop UX without moving destructive authority away from local nodes.
exit_criteria: Remote target protocol preserves local safety authority.
OSS/commercial boundary remains intact.
Desktop is a client, not a parallel implementation.
